summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting an operational update on a fire at its Goose Mine's crushing circuit on April 16, 2026. The incident caused no injuries and damage was localized to the crushing area, with no mill or power facility impact. The company plans to use mobile crushers and temporary crushing capacity to feed ore, with repairs expected by Q3 2026. Preliminary repair cost is ~C$10 million. Q2 2026 gold production forecast is reduced from ~29,000 oz to 18,000-20,000 oz, but full-year guidance of 170,000-230,000 oz remains unchanged. This is an operational incident update, not a special situation.
